Batch 11 is the best fallback: crystal_yield 0.4476, crystal_purity 0.9947, and one of the lowest final fines values (0.5872). Its fines result is numerically close to batch 7's 0.5753 relative to declared assay noise, while recovery is higher and the process is simpler.
